entities.summary: Jonathon Merrill is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman. He most recently played for the Minnesota Wild of the National Hockey League (NHL). He has previously also played for the New Jersey Devils, Vegas Golden Knights, Detroit Red Wings, Montreal Canadiens. The Devils selected Merrill in the second round, 38th overall, of the 2010 NHL entry draft.
